question: does the diffusion model capture structure an order-3 Markov chain cannot?
why_order3: an order-3 chain's sufficient statistic IS the 4-mer conditional distribution

eval.set: withheld MG1655 promoter windows whose gene has NO draft counterpart
eval.strain_note: corpus E. coli is GCA_059754755.1 (draft); eval is GCF_000005845.2 (MG1655). Withheld by sequence AND the gene has no draft counterpart. The CLEAN arm of the leak contrast

provenance.selection: a seeded random sample (seed 0) of the sorted distinct sequences

why_primary: left_only matches the information budget (both see only the unmasked left prefix) and markov_ecoli is the STRONG 4-mer null, fit on the E. coli the model actually trained on. The pooled chain is reported because it is the same-data pairing, but it barely beats uniform and is the WEAK null.
verdict_detail: The chain beats the model by 0.0127 nats, CI [-0.0181, -0.0074]. Do NOT close on this alone: the eval set is accessory-gene biased, so this is confounded with out-of-distribution failure rather than absence of signal beyond 4-mers. The representative re-pretrain is what settles it.
